tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel and card ground. The drawer plays off white; color arrives as full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines, card outlines, the Pro block ground. Navy — never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: narratives, strength one-liners, button labels on white. 7.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tiny labels (THE READ, EVIDENCE) and the meta footer. Nothing below 10px.

tokens.name: chartreuse
tokens.usage: The brand highlight. The Read band, working checkmarks, the Pro CTA. Always carries ink text — never white.

tokens.name: chartreuse-tint
tokens.usage: Soft chip ground ('3 things working'). Pair with chartreuse-ink text.

tokens.name: chartreuse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on chartreuse-tint chips.

tokens.name: pink-mascot
tokens.usage: The mascot's body. Reserved for the mascot — don't spend it on UI chrome.

tokens.name: pink-band
tokens.usage: 'What's costing you' band ground in the full-color direction.

tokens.name: pink-tint
tokens.usage: Soft chip ground ('3 costing you'). Pair with pink-ink text.

tokens.name: pink-ink
tokens.usage: Text on pink-tint chips.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Action. Show me buttons, links, the Pro band. 6.9:1 with white text.

tokens.name: cobalt-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of cobalt, link hover.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Evidence and quote blocks inside cards — paper against the white card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: secondary buttons, outline chips, the technical-checks row.

tokens.name: impact-high
tokens.usage: HIGH impact chip ground. Pair with impact-high-ink.

tokens.name: impact-high-ink
tokens.usage: Text on impact-high. Rust, not alarm-red — we inform, we don't scold.

tokens.name: impact-medium
tokens.usage: MEDIUM impact chip ground. Pair with impact-medium-ink.

tokens.name: impact-medium-ink
tokens.usage: Text on impact-medium.

tokens.name: impact-low
tokens.usage: LOW impact chip ground. Pair with impact-low-ink.

tokens.name: impact-low-ink
tokens.usage: Text on impact-low.

tokens.name: on-dark-body
tokens.usage: Body text on ink or cobalt grounds (Pro block bullets).

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on the ink ground (the price line).

tokens.name: on-cobalt-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on the cobalt ground.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip padding vertical, icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chip rows and button rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and rows inside a band.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Finding card inner padding. Tight on purpose — the panel is 380px.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Larger inner padding (Pro block: 18px rounds up from here).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Panel side gutter. 380px panel − 2×18 = 344px content measure. Every band uses it.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Band bottom padding; breathing room between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, section pills, every button. Pills are the house shape.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Evidence blocks and other nested surfaces inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Finding cards, the technical-checks row.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: The Pro block and other full-width feature blocks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Flat offset shadow on outlined cards over white. Print-like, never blurred.

tokens.name: shadow-card-band
tokens.usage: Same shadow, softened, for white cards sitting on color bands.
